201210.overview:
In the past, the demon world and the human world were one world...
Humans and demons were engaged in a fierce battle. And it seemed that the battle would continue forever. People fought each other with magic and science, and demons fought each other with their strong bodies and full of magical power. The world was in chaos. It was like hell. The grass withered and the earth rotted. A massive clash of magical forces was taking away all life on the land. Both humans and demons knew this and fought for it. For their own sake... And the world collapsed.

Then one day, a man and a woman landed on this earth. The man called himself Gilpharas and the woman Lunatilis. They divided his land into the world of humans and the world of demons. They then invited their people to each world. Later, the human world would be called Elkador and the demon world Grande. Later, Gilpharas was revered as the "Sun God" and Lunatilis as the "Moon God. The same lore from the same period is handed down in the temples of the sun and the moon....

... Chaos fills the world at the end of time, but if we realize that it is an omen, it will not happen again... the sun will bring peace and prosperity to his land, and the moon will bring war and calamity to his land...
